cohort: 1443 mother-child dyads (children < 2 years old) in urban slums of Pune city, India
finding: Caesarean delivery and very low birth weight were negatively associated with early initiation of breastfeeding, while delivery in a public health care facility was positively associated with early initiation and exclusive breastfeeding.
mod_finding: Caesarean delivery decreased the odds of early initiation and exclusive breastfeeding, while it increased the odds of prelacteal feeding.
